name: NEXUS Site Enquiry to Gmail Notification

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, notified: true, submission_id: $('Compose Notification').item.json.submission_id }) }}

parameters.content:
## Site enquiry to Gmail

The NEXUS marketing site posts here. The mail is sent from the Gmail
credential that already serves the drip and escalation workflows, so this
path needs no Resend account and no third-party sending domain.

THE DOOR IS GUARDED BY n8n ITSELF. authentication headerAuth means a request
without the matching header is refused before any execution starts - unlike
the eleven older business webhooks, every one of which accepts the request
first and refuses downstream.

THE EMAIL BODY IS BUILT HERE, NEVER PASSED THROUGH. Compose Notification reads
seven allowlisted fields, strips control characters, caps every length and
refuses an enquiry with no name or no way to reply. Somebody holding the
header still cannot make this mail arbitrary text.

NOTHING IS WRITTEN TO ANY DEALERSHIP RECORD, DELIBERATELY. A person filling in
the NEXUS site is a prospect for the vendor, not a car buyer belonging to a
dealership. Filing them into leads or audit_log would put the vendor pipeline
inside a customer's data - the exact boundary this product exists to hold.
